| 2 | Samuel Adams (Massachusetts) |
| 3 | John Adams (Massachusetts) |

These individuals represented the thirteen colonies and formally endorsed the Declaration on August 2, 1776, at the Pennsylvania State House (now Independence Hall) in Philadelphia.
